changelog:
slidev-datav-dashboard 1.0.0

- Initial release: Build large-screen data-visualization dashboards (大屏) as Slidev presentations using the datav-vue3 component library.
- Includes ready-to-use layout/panel assets, dark-theme design rules, 1920×1080 canvas scaling, and a full example deck.
- Supports all 39 DataV components (border-boxes, decorations, charts, indicators, etc.).
- Provides a one-command scaffold script and detailed references for components, design, integration, and troubleshooting.
- Workflow guides for project setup, panel placement, and data binding.
summary: Build large-screen data-visualization dashboards (大屏 / 数据大屏 / 可视化大屏) as Slidev presentations using the datav-vue3 (DataV) component library. Use when the user wants a data dashboard
